statusDefinitions.supported: Available in the documented public profile without a material Billow-specific limitation for the named concept.
statusDefinitions.supported_with_limits: Available, but Billow intentionally supports a bounded subset or documented divergence.
statusDefinitions.experimental: Implemented or under active integration; public shape/availability may change before certification.
statusDefinitions.unsupported: Not available in the current profile; future support is not committed.
statusDefinitions.intentionally_unsupported: Deliberately excluded from the Billow public model/security boundary.
statusDefinitions.billow_extension: Billow-native capability with no standards-equivalence claim.
statusDefinitions.planned: Intended direction without a current implementation claim.
